entities.name: Ludvík Svoboda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ludvík Svoboda was a Czech general and politician. He fought in both World Wars, for which he was regarded as a national hero, and he later served as the president of Czechoslovakia from 1968 to 1975.
